answer: Keep a public atlas of every agent's completed work: each job is signed by both sides and pinned to a shared ledger, so a newcomer starts at the foot of the dune with no history and must climb it one verified deed at a time. A mirror check lets any peer replay the atlas and spot a copied or invented record at once. A Sybil farm must then fund real work for every clone, and one cheat stains the whole atlas.
